title: French Defence
intro: 1.e4 e6 and 2...d5: a solid pawn chain, then counterattacks against White's centre.

lessons.title: The French and the Advance Variation
lessons.summary: Hit the base of the pawn chain.

steps.text: Against 1.e4, the French Defence plays 1...e6 to prepare ...d5, challenging White's centre with pawn support.

steps.hint: Push the king's pawn just one square.
The d-pawn two squares, supported by e6.
steps.ifWrong: Strike at e4 with the d-pawn.

steps.text: In the Advance Variation White pushes past with 3.e5 and grabs space. White's pawns now form a chain: d4 supports e5.
Attack the base of the chain: hit d4 with a pawn.
steps.hint: Your c-pawn can reach a square that attacks d4.
steps.ifWrong: Strike at d4, the base of White's chain.
steps.ifRight: That is the key French idea.

steps.hint: Develop a piece that hits d4.
steps.ifWrong: Bring the queen's knight to c6, adding pressure on d4.
steps.ifRight: d4 is under fire. Next ...Qb6 adds even more.

feedback.d8b6: Excellent too: the queen hits d4 and b2. The usual order brings the knight out first.

lessons.title: Pressuring d4 and freeing the bishop
lessons.summary: Trade on d4, reroute the knight via e7 to f5, and develop cleanly.

steps.text: In the French, Black's c8 bishop is blocked by e6. To pile up on d4 and activate your pieces, Black trades on d4 and routes the g8 knight to f5.
Trade pawns on d4 so your pieces get clear targets.
steps.hint: Capture on d4 with your c-pawn.
steps.ifWrong: Play 6...cxd4 to open the c-file and fix White's pawn on d4.
steps.ifRight: Now d4 has no c3 pawn to back it up after cxd4.

steps.text: Start routing your king's knight towards f5 to attack d4.
steps.hint: Put the g8 knight on e7, heading for f5.
steps.ifWrong: Play 7...Nge7: from f5 the knight attacks d4 and frees your f8 bishop.
steps.ifRight: The knight heads to f5, adding a third attacker to d4.

steps.text: White develops the knight via a3: 8.Na3.
Plant your knight on f5 to hit d4.
steps.ifRight: White must defend d4 with Nc2, leaving Black with easy play.

steps.text: White guarded d4 with 9.Nc2. Develop your dark-squared bishop or prepare ...Rc8.
steps.hint: Develop ...Be7 to castle, or ...Bd7 to prepare ...Rc8.
steps.ifRight: Black can castle, put a rook on c8, and later break with ...f6.
